primitives.name: Plug-in Noise Subtraction
primitives.verbatim_quote: The plug-in noise subtraction `max(0, raw - noise)` — does it over-subtract when a real gap exists?
primitives.assumptions: Noise is additive and independent of true signal; over-subtraction occurs when real gaps exist.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When raw < noise, resulting signal becomes zero despite valid signal presence.

primitives.name: Selective Gate Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Is the selective gate (delta=0.1 on marketFairProb) the right structure?
primitives.assumptions: Model probability deviates significantly from market fair probability beyond threshold delta.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Gate fails when model and market align closely but still diverge due to inefficiency.

layer2.mapping: Dual logic of market validation and internal consistency check in GSI's pick selection.

primitives.name: Leverage Formula
primitives.verbatim_quote: `leverage = ceiling / (proj * own)` — does this properly capture contrarian upside?
primitives.assumptions: Contrarian upside scales inversely with projected performance and self-weighting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero or undefined when proj = 0 or own = 0.
